# Introduction

Deathsquitos are aggressive creatures found in Plains. They are, as their name suggests, enlarged mosquito-type bugs that give off a loud buzzing noise.

### Drops

• Item: Deathsquito trophy | 0 Star: 5%

• Item: Needle | 0 Star: 1

### Spawning

• Type: Anywhere in Plains | Limit: 3 | Frequency: Uncommon | Stars: No

### Sting

Lunges forward to stab the player with their proboscis (90 Pierce damage). This hits in a 1.6-meter 60-degree horizontal arc. It can use this attack every 10 seconds when 1.5 meters from a player.

## Notes

• Despite their size, Deathsquitos are one of the most deadly creatures due to their relative speed and high pierce damage.
